title: Paloma Business Administrator Guide: Users, Roles and Seats
content:
The owner of a Paloma Business account adds and removes its users. Each user has one role: admin, approver, preparer or viewer. The owner counts as one active user.

### Rules in force

1. A user can be added only while the account is active or past due, as the account record shows.
2. A user may be added only when the account's active users stay at or below the plan's largest number of active users, including the new user. Active users are 1 for the owner plus every user whose latest record is an addition rather than a removal, read from the account's user records.
3. A user who is already active is not added again.
4. Removing a user takes effect at once, and the owner can never be removed.

### Retired rule

The former rule under which a user added during a period whose active users then exceeded the included seats was charged the plan's extra seat fee for that period at once, as an extra seat fee numbered in the period from 1, not prorated and not refunded when the user was removed, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for mid-period extra seat charges.

### Administrator Q&A

**How many active users does an account with the owner and four added users, one of whom was later removed, have?** Four: the owner plus the three users whose latest record is an addition.

**May a fifth active user be added on a plan whose largest number of active users is 5, when 4 are active?** Yes: with the new user the active users are 5, which stays at or below 5.

**May a sixth be added when 5 are active on the same plan?** No: the active users would be 6.

**Can the owner be removed to make room?** No. The owner can never be removed.

**Can a user be added while the account is suspended?** No. Users are added only while the account is active or past due.

superseded_clauses: A user added during a period whose active users then exceed included_seats is charged extra_seat_fee_usd for that period at once, as extra_seat_fee with seq_in_period numbering such mid-period charges from 1; the fee is not prorated and not refunded when the user is removed.
